name: Spanish Tortilla de Patatas with White Bean Tomato Salad

components.name: Tortilla de Patatas

ingredients.name: Raw potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
Raw whole eggs without shells, about ten large

steps: Slice potatoes thinly so they cook evenly; warm olive oil in a wide nonstick skillet and gently cook potato and onion covered, 15-20 minutes, stirring, until tender without burning.
Drain any free oil into the skillet, then lightly cool the potatoes. Beat the weighed eggs and salt and fold in potatoes/onions.
Pour into the nonstick pan over medium-low heat; cook slowly until edges are set and centre nearly firm.
Flip with a flat plate or use a covered skillet to finish, until the centre is fully cooked and set; avoid a runny centre for stored meals.
Cut tortilla into four wedges and portion with white bean salad; freeze tortilla only if its post-thaw texture passes kitchen testing.

components.name: White Bean Tomato Salad

ingredients.name: Canned white beans drained and rinsed

steps: Toss drained white beans, diced tomato and onion with lemon, olive oil and parsley; keep chilled separately.
